d.t: The act of one who kowtows; a submissive bow.
d.e: Yoritomo met their smiles and kowtowings and noisy insuckings of breath with an austere dignity that I took pains to imitate.

d.t: A German communist.
d.e: The SPD contended that the Communists—whom it referred to as “Kozis"—were the mere lackeys of the Nazis. Vorwaerts insisted that the BVG strike was but a prelude to a putsch.
